data.body: **[P2] Preserve settled outcomes for all nonfatal inline restoration failures.** The guard only catches `RuntimeException`. If `MDC.clear()` or `setContextMap()` throws a direct non-JVM-fatal `Error` such as `LinkageError` or `AssertionError`, line 269 has already settled `result`, but an inline executor propagates that error past this catch and replaces the selected success, suspension, or retry outcome. Catch `Throwable`, rethrow when `result` is not done, and otherwise propagate only failures selected by `rethrowLifecycleFatal`; add an inline nonfatal-`Error` regression.
